enemies.name: Nestling
enemies.notes: Each attack steals 1 orb from the Mycelia Shared pool (party-wide pool in U3). Break: drops a feather map (reveals one canopy thermal).

enemies.name: Moon Egg
enemies.notes: Mercy puzzle. It never attacks (Moon Hum is a harmless idle). Takes 0 HP damage until Broken (shield_only). Once Broken, a single hit shatters it into Sunlight x3; leaving it Broken and walking away lets it hatch later (+Light).

enemies.name: Eden Wisp
enemies.notes: Every 6 s it is not Broken it restores 2 plates to an ally (a battle-time timer; the action is the turn-based stand-in). Pollen made of porcelain.

enemies.name: Bramble-Rex Saurian
enemies.notes: Charger. Every charge that misses snaps a tree, leaving new cover on the battle plane.

enemies.name: Gene Scribe
enemies.notes: Writes FAILED in ink across the 28 x 28 plane: a slow field (0.5x movement) that persists on the floor, not only a status. Regenerates under Divinity (temporary plates from the Divinity Field). Break: silences it for 15 s (Silence on itself).

enemies.name: Synod Acolyte
enemies.notes: Moonlight buff: every 15 s it is not Broken, it restores 4 plates to an ally (battle-time timer; every_n_turns 2 is the turn-based stand-in).

enemies.name: Porcelain Raptor
enemies.notes: Cloaks near porcelain-mask galaxy leaves (untargetable while cloaked; a Mercury Pulse or a Tether pulse uncloaks it; nothing can be untargetable inside a Static field).

enemies.name: Unfallen Pupa
enemies.notes: A Lavos spawn of the world where Lavos never fell. Floats and never attacks unless attacked (the brain must stay passive until it has taken a hit). Killing it unprovoked gives +10 Dark and closes the Golden Light ending for this cycle. No crack: slime.

enemies.name: Crown Saurian
enemies.notes: Airborne and untouchable (immune to every hit while airborne) until a Mycelia Tether snap drags it down. Break: it falls and stays grounded for the full Break.

enemies.name: Lichen Colony
enemies.notes: Three bodies (encounters list it x3; shield 6 per body) sharing damage 15% across a living tether. Hitting it fast triggers the Fake Carrier Burn (pollen browns, vinyl crackle, the Shared bar jitters, zero real damage): fires if more than 6 Shared orbs burn in 10 s.
